notes.title: Challenge Mode Update! - Version 0.1.300
notes.content:
[img=http://i.imgur.com/ve6KxhM.png]

[b]The AI Bot Challenge Mode update is now live![/b]

In this update we have the introduction of AI enemies into the existing challenge modes to form the new challenge modes. This is our first foray into having AI enemies in challenge modes and we'll be watching player feedback closely so make your voice heard!

We hope you enjoy this mid-month mini update as the BCDM team work hard to bring you a much larger update coming at the end of this month!

Want to give feedback?
Chat on Discord: https://discord.gg/JwYYbk9
Post on Twitter: https://twitter.com/OfficialBCDM
Post on Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/BCDM/

You can read the exact changes below! 

[b]----------------------------------------- NEW CHALLENGE MODE #3 & #4 -------------------------------- [/b]
A far harder version of the existing challenge modes, these new challenges include infinitely re-spawning AI enemies who will come at you again and again!

Unlike deathmatch mode, when you die the challenge is immediately ended so ignoring them is not an option.

Once defeated, the AI enemy will respawn further down the map and after a 7 second delay, will begin hunting you anew.

However, skilled players who find the first two challenge modes too easy will be able to rack up a far higher score as each AI balloon popped earns you 15 points and each kill earns you 200 points!


[b]------------------------------------------------------- OTHER ----------------------------------------------------- [/b]
We have reduced the 30 second wait after each challenge mode down to a 10 second wait as we found it too long when you just wanted to try again.

notes.title: Bots & Challenge Mode Update! - Version 0.1.200
notes.content:
[img=http://i.imgur.com/8sgBjIZ.png]

The Bots & Challenge Mode Update is now live! We're very proud to introduce our first ever update for Balloon Chair Death Match with many many more to come! 

You can read the exact changes below!

----------------------------------------- [b]NEW DEATHMATCH BOTS[/b] -------------------------------------------
With it comes an all new bots system to either populate multiplayer games with, or to just play deathmatch solo against the AI!

To use the bots, simply go into a multiplayer game as host and press "Start game with bots". This will fill all empty player slots with bots! So if you're alone in the lobby, you'll end up playing against three bots. If you're in there with one other player, the two of you will enter a deathmatch with two bots etc..

However the "Start game" button still exists if you don't want bots in your game!


---------------------------------------- [b]NEW CHALLENGE MODE MAP[/b] ---------------------------------------
A new challenge mode map can now be accessed via the challenge mode menu! The new map focuses far more on vertical movement and manoeuvrability, so you'll likely find it's far more challenging than the first map!

The challenge map also comes with it's own leader board, seperate to that of challenge mode #1.


---------------------------------- [b]SCREEN RECORDING IMPROVEMENTS[/b] ---------------------------------
We've made improvements to the monitor display for Balloon Chair Death Match to make it easier to record your screen, or just make it easier for your friend to watch you play :)

On both the HTC Vive and the Oculus Rift you'll now get a full field-of-view display of what  the player is seeing.

Previously, the Rift showed to mirrored two-eye view, and the Vive showed a single narrow view.


We the team of Balloon Chair Death Match hope you enjoy the new update and look forward to bringing you loads of great new stuff in the new year!

Until then, have a good holiday and a happy new year!
